principles.name: Reduction
principles.question: What can you remove until the screen still works?

principles.name: Interaction with purpose
principles.question: What changes when the user acts — and does it serve the job, not decoration?

principles.name: Atmosphere responds
principles.question: How does the environment react to focus, progress, or state — not sit as wallpaper?

principles.name: Type as structure
principles.question: How does typography carry hierarchy without extra chrome?

principles.name: One color world
principles.question: What is the one committed color field or material — and why this product?

principles.name: Quiet editorial
principles.question: Where does whitespace and list rhythm do the selling?

principles.name: Product proves itself
principles.question: How does the UI show the product working — not describe it?

principles.name: Task clarity
principles.question: Can a tired user complete this in one pass without hunting?
